text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has once again started, and this camp will be a critical part of our preparations for our showdown with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I show Biwa Hayahide the data that I've meticulously prepared. There's a vast amount of notes, covering everything from her next race to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing the volume of data, she realizes the sheer effort I used to gather it all and begins worrying about my health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our second summer camp will bring us one step closer to completing her winning equation.
